summary:
A piece works exactly when the singers outside it have at most `n/4` of each voice: then the piece can be
repainted to fill every shortfall. Keep counts of the voices outside a sliding window; grow the window, and
while the outside is within limits, record the window and shrink it. O(n).

question.md:
Repaint one contiguous piece of `s` (any voices you like) so each of `S A T B` appears exactly `n/4` times.
Return the shortest such piece (0 if already balanced).

- **n up to 10⁵**, a multiple of 4.

think.md:
`"SSATSSBS"` (n/4 = 2): the surplus is {'S': 3}, so the piece must at least contain those extra singers. Answer:
**4**.

What's outside the piece stays as it is, so no voice may exceed `2` outside. Conversely, if every voice is
at most `2` outside, the piece has exactly enough singers to top each voice up to `2` (the counts add up to
`n`). So the condition only depends on the outside counts, and it stays true when the piece grows: a shortest
window problem.

idea.md: If already balanced, 0. Otherwise, for each start, extend the piece (moving singers from the outside counts) until every outside count is ≤ `n/4`.

lines.text: Voice counts; if three voices are at `n/4`, so is the fourth, and nothing needs changing.
Move singers into the piece until no voice outside exceeds `n/4`.

walk.title: From each start, extend the piece until the singers left outside have at most n/4 of every voice.

limits.md: Restarts the outside counts for every start.

approaches.title: Shrinking window on the outside counts

idea.md: `out[c]` = count of voice `c` outside the window (initially all of `s`). For each `r`: `out[s[r]] −= 1`; while every `out[c] ≤ n/4`: record, `out[s[left]] += 1`, `left += 1`.

build: Counts start as the whole string.
Window takes singers out of the counts.
Record and shrink while the outside is fine.

lines.text: Before any window, everyone is outside. Already balanced means 0.
The outside is within limits, so this piece works; try giving back the leftmost singer. (It can't shrink to empty, since the string isn't balanced.)

steps.text: Add S (index 4). Valid: shrink while it stays valid (shortest ending here: 0..4, length 5).
Add S (index 5). Valid: shrink while it stays valid (shortest ending here: 1..5, length 5).
Add S (index 7). Valid: shrink while it stays valid (shortest ending here: 4..7, length 4).

walk.title: Count voices outside the window. Grow the window (removing singers from 'outside'); while every outside count is ≤ n/4, record the window and shrink it from the left.

takeaways.md:
- **Reframe "what to change" as "what stays":** the outside must already be within limits.
- Track counts of the complement of the window.
- Then it's the standard shortest-valid-window template.
